target.title: Fix Kiro CLI timeout fallback
target.body:
## Summary

- prefer bounded pipe-backed Kiro CLI probes for current releases
- retain the existing PTY path as a bounded fallback for older Kiro CLIs
- preserve exit status, cancellation, idle-output validation, and residual process cleanup
- add regressions for both pipe-only and PTY-only Kiro behavior

Closes #1883.

## Root cause

Current Kiro CLI releases can return normally through pipes but stall when CodexBar launches them directly under a PTY. CodexBar 0.41.0 then reaches its 20-second deadline even though the same `/usage` request completes directly in about 2.4 seconds.

Older Kiro releases had the inverse behavior and required PTY output. The fix therefore keeps both transports: bounded pipes first, then PTY only when the pipe probe produces no usable completion.

Live signed-app reproduction and sanitized trace evidence are recorded in #1883.

## Validation

- `swiftc -swift-version 6 -parse Sources/CodexBarCore/Providers/Kiro/KiroStatusProbe.swift Tests/CodexBarTests/KiroStatusProbeTests.swift`
- `git diff --check`
- SwiftFormat: 0/1330 files require formatting
- repository/package/script/documentation checks passed before SwiftLint
- live CodexBar 0.41.0 + Kiro CLI 2.12.0 reproduction: direct request 2.41s; PTY request timed out at 20s; pipe-output workaround returned the full snapshot in 3.7-3.9s

## Local environment limits

- `swift test --filter KiroStatusProbeTests` reaches the build but cannot run because this Mac has Command Line Tools only; `actool` requires full Xcode
- `make check` reaches SwiftLint, which cannot load `sourcekitdInProc` from the Command Line Tools installation

CI should provide the full Xcode toolchain for the focused and complete test suites.
